summary: Somerset County, ME summit (2,460 ft) on the Appalachian Trail; steel tower erected 1917, moved to Barren Mountain in 1951; lookout footings photographed; FFLA lists it gone.

facts.design: 24-foot steel tower erected 1917; 36-foot steel tower in the 1920 inventory
facts.status_note: Summit lookout gone; the tower was moved to Barren Mountain (Piscataquis County) in 1951, where WillhiteWeb says it still stands without its cab

access.note: Appalachian Trail runs over the summit, per WillhiteWeb 'AT Access: Trail over the summit'

visit.trail_note: Appalachian Trail over the summit; no lookout structure on the summit is described as standing today

notes_for_editor: Main source is WillhiteWeb's Appalachian Trail lookout page, which is undated and cites nothing. The Barren Mountain page gives the same 1951 move and says the tower still stands without its cab. The FFLA list gives status and coordinates. The footing photos have no dates, so the story does not say when they were taken. Two Facebook search snippets from the FFLA Maine chapter give 1950 for the camp's abandonment and the move; they were not fetched, so they are not used. No staffing or fire records found in sources read. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 4 page reads.
